bodyRollover:
Please be advised that the vessel {vO} was impacted by move restrictions during her port call in order to maintain her berth window. Due to unexpected delays during cargo operations, part of the import cargo could not be discharged and remained on board upon vessel departure. The cargo will be re-arranged to the next available sailing on {vN}.

We are sorry for the inconvenience caused, which was beyond owner´s control, and thank you in advance for your understanding and usual support.

In case any additional clarification is required, please do not hesitate to contact your Local Sales Representative and/or Customer Service Team.
